metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2005 · Iqbal
metas.description: Iqbal, the deaf and mute son of a farmer, has a passion for the game of cricket and seeks the tutelage of a washed-up, alcoholic ex-player.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2008 · Bigger Stronger Faster*
metas.description: An examination of America's win-at-all-cost culture from the perspective of bodybuilding and performance enhancing drugs, as it focuses on a pair of siblings chasing their dream.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2001 · Dogtown and Z-Boys
metas.description: Documentary about the pioneering 1970s Zephyr skating team.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2005 · Murderball
metas.description: Quadriplegics, who play full-contact rugby in wheelchairs, overcome unimaginable obstacles to compete in the Paralympic Games in Athens, Greece.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2008 · More Than a Game
metas.description: This documentary follows NBA superstar LeBron James and four of his talented teammates through the trials and tribulations of high school basketball in Ohio and James' journey to fame.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2005 · The Rocket
metas.description: A story about Quebec's most famous hockey player, Maurice "The Rocket" Richard, focusing on the struggles of a French Canadian in the National Hockey League dominated by Anglophones.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2009 · Metastases
metas.description: Four friends from the neighborhood grapple with maintaining their relationships amid the challenges of alcohol, drugs, hooliganism, crime, and the shadows of their country's history.
